Oklahoma 'Core to Shore' Master Plan Visualisation

Andy CASA, UCL East


Oklahoma City's "Core to Shore" - by skylineink from imagiNATIVEamerica on Vimeo.


Skyline Ink have produced a visualisation of Oklahoma's 'Core to Shore' Master Plan. While its nice, we don't quite get the 'video' on the bridge part and there's something about it that does not quite work.

That said, if you head over to the Skyline ink website they have a movie of the Mid-Town Renaissance that its simple stunning, if you have five minutes it is well worth a play.
